criteria.intent: Audit article route ownership and test impact before full gates.
criteria.automated_scope: ANALYTICS exercises public catalog admission, refusal cases and changing-loader identity; the dated audit and affected test allocation require review.

criteria.intent: Measure direct and supported internal article entries with one SDK.
criteria.automated_scope: ANALYTICS checks the actual compiled producer loader, canonical/alias admission, shared document invalidation and one SDK element; it does not establish vendor-generated pageviews or collector receipt.

criteria.intent: Preserve bounded analytics and QA isolation.
criteria.automated_scope: ANALYTICS exercises origin/project, draft/unlisted/unknown/snapshot refusals, blocked SDK, offline stripping and context-isolation failure/ordinary contrasts; actual browser and live isolation scope remain separate.

criteria.intent: Complete truthful site-original SEO and author metadata.
criteria.automated_scope: BASIC checks current generated output and syntax only; SEO implementation and semantic/live metadata verification are outside the analytics checkpoint and remain pending.

criteria.intent: Complete contextual discovery and Medium edition links.
criteria.automated_scope: BASIC checks general output coherence only; new discovery links and desktop/mobile/no-JS acceptance are outside this checkpoint.

criteria.intent: Verify existing search infrastructure and article inclusion.
criteria.automated_scope: BASIC verifies generated artifact coherence only, not live sitemap, canonical coverage, indexing or provider inspection.

criteria.intent: Run exact-source checks, independent reviews and authorized release gates with source architecture/style.
criteria.automated_scope: BASIC, STYLE, RI and RI-CI check their bounded source/output/guard scopes. Four-role semantic review, CS01-CS10 outside the guard, hosted preview/staging and separately authorized production remain external gates.

criteria.intent: Record honest fixed-window analytics before/after evidence.
criteria.automated_scope: ANALYTICS preserves collection guard behavior only; sampled reporting, provider counts, retrieval windows and contamination interpretation require dated evidence and remain pending.

criteria.intent: Remind owner after production and retain owner-only Medium canonical disposition.
criteria.automated_scope: BASIC establishes no Medium action. Final post-production reminder and explicit owner result are unautomated and remain pending.

REVIEW.description: Four distinct nonauthor requirements, code, white-box and exploratory executions on the exact candidate; review test impact and applicable CS01-CS10 beyond the guard.

BROWSER.description: Actual compiled article canonical/alias/reload and internal/history journeys, blocked/staging/offline behavior and existing QA isolation contrast on the exact candidate; provider counts are not stub observations.

LIVE.description: After separately authorized deployment, verify actual served loader/article identities and SDK-generated route/history/reload/query/fragment behavior separately from aggregate provider receipt; never infer exactly-once collection from SDK count.

SEO.description: Pending original AC04 implementation and authoritative truthful metadata plus actual production verification; no SEO completion in this checkpoint.

DISCOVERY.description: Pending original AC05 links and desktop/mobile/no-JS checks; no new discovery implementation in this checkpoint.

SEARCH.description: Pending existing robots/sitemap/article canonical coverage and dated Search Console result or explicit unavailable disposition under issue8.

RELEASE.description: Exact-source preview, maintainer review, authorized full stable staging and separate owner-authorized production/live verification. Current checkpoint stops before promotion, merge or deployment.

BASELINE.description: Fixed equal-window raw/provider reporting with dates, samples, QA limitations and missing referrers; prior article totals incomplete, no causal uplift claim.

MEDIUM.description: After verified production, explicitly remind maintainer; owner personally records DONE/UNAVAILABLE/DECIDED NOT TO SET for this article's canonical. Agent cannot supply it.
